title: MSFragger to CurtainPTM Converter pipeline parameters
description: Convert MSFragger PTM single site output to CurtainPTM upload format. Extracts PTM positions from index columns, maps peptide sequences to proteins, and generates sequence windows around modification sites. Based on: Phung et al. (2024) PNAS 121(7):e2312676121. Repository: https://github.com/noatgnu/curtain-utils

plugin_parameters.title: Plugin parameters
plugin_parameters.description: Parameters for the MSFragger to CurtainPTM Converter plugin.

fasta_file.description: Protein sequence FASTA file. If not provided, sequences will be fetched from UniProt automatically.

get_position_from_peptide.description: Enable this to extract PTM position from lowercase residues in the peptide sequence instead of the index column

index_col.description: Column name containing site information with accession ID and PTM position (e.g., P12345_S123)

input_file.description: MSFragger PTM output file containing differential analysis with site information in the Index column

output_filename.description: Name of the output file (will be created in the output folder)

sequence_window_size.description: Size of the sequence window around modification sites (must be odd number). Default is 21 (10 residues before + modification + 10 after).

uniprot_columns.description: Comma-separated list of UniProt columns to retrieve when fetching sequences online
